pages.quiz:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #2
====

GRADE: PP1
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Names of Scriptures? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Names of Scriptures.
   B. Use Names of Scriptures to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Names of Scriptures with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Names of Scriptures has no place in daily life.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Simple postures? (1 mark)
   A. Say Simple postures has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Simple postures with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Simple postures to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Simple postures.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Myself? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Myself.
   B. Say Myself has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Myself to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Myself with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Cheating in exams
   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Spreading rumours
   D. Hiding stolen items

5. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

6. Which response best shows understanding of Places of Worship? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Places of Worship with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Places of Worship to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Places of Worship has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Places of Worship.

7. Which response best shows understanding of General Etiquette? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing General Etiquette.
   B. Apply the teaching of General Etiquette with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say General Etiquette has no place in daily life.
   D. Use General Etiquette to insult classmates of other faiths.

8. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Destroy trees without planting
   B. Waste food daily
   C. Pollute rivers deliberately
   D. Care for the environment and use resources wisely

9. Which response best shows understanding of The Enlightened Beings? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of The Enlightened Beings with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use The Enlightened Beings to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Enlightened Beings.
   D. Say The Enlightened Beings has no place in daily life.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
10. In three clear sentences, explain The Enlightened Beings and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

11. In three clear sentences, explain Names of Scriptures and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Simple postures and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain General Etiquette and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Myself and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Places of Worship and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
